proposed_connector.name: edgar_fts.counterparty_partnership_scan
proposed_connector.description: Multi-counterparty edgar fulltext partnership-scan helper that takes a list of named counterparties and runs an edgar_fts query against each public counterparty's filings looking for the focal company name; consolidates results into a per-counterparty hit table.
proposed_connector.endpoint: wrapper over edgar_fts.query_fulltext + a name-to-CIK resolver
proposed_connector.rationale: Multi-partner supplier-name lists are common in pre-revenue SPAC filings. Existing edgar_fts requires one call per CIK; a multi-counterparty wrapper would scale this test efficiently. Public counterparties (Meritor MTOR, Nel ASA on Oslo Bors, AVL private) get cross-checked for any mention of the focal company.
proposed_connector.completeness: SEC EDGAR-registered counterparties only; private counterparties (AVL, EDAG, Mahle) need other registries
